method: Local production builds; 1280x800 CSS pixels, DPR 2.36; shared 10 Mbit/s plus 100ms response latency; no browser cache. Interface readiness is the first hydrated click-area DOM node with the preview loaded, not a universal TTI guarantee.
behavior: The 39,438-byte captured room and live navigation labels render first. Room images begin after the preview/first paint and hydration; scene appearance still waits for real image decoding. Pose preparation remains after the room. The board retains its own decode/font gate.
failureVerification: A preview response held for 10 seconds did not prevent data-scene-ready=true; the preview image was still incomplete when the real room and board became ready.
earlyNavigation: A projects click before sceneReady was accepted and the panel opened. Under the synthetic HTTP/1 throttling its content can still wait about 3 seconds for the separate section bundle. Background image priority is low; navigation latency is not represented by interfaceReadyMs. An experimental dynamic module warmup added requests without improving the transition and was removed.
tests: Production build: 35 pages; TypeScript; make test; public packaging; all 277 assets and 18 RU/EN routes return successfully; normal browser console clean.
